# Monkeytype Pro

> A minimalist, zero-latency browser-native typing speed test (WPM) engine inspired by Monkeytype. Built with zero dependencies, 100% client-side execution, and private keystroke processing.

## Overview
Monkeytype Pro provides a seamless keyboard velocity benchmark for software developers, typists, transcribers, and competitive typists. It replaces ad-heavy legacy typing tests with a dark, distraction-free interface and precise metrics.

## Key Technical Specifications & Features
- **Latency:** Sub-5ms client-side input registration with direct DOM rendering.
- **WPM Calculation Standard:** International 5-keystroke normalization:
  - `Gross WPM = (Total Keystrokes / 5) / Time Elapsed (Minutes)`
  - `Net WPM = Gross WPM - (Uncorrected Errors / Time Elapsed)`
  - `Accuracy = (Correct Keystrokes / Total Keystrokes) * 100%`
- **Supported Modes:** 15-second, 30-second, and 60-second time limits.
- **Shortcuts:** Instant reset via `Tab` key.
- **Privacy Standard:** Zero keystroke logging. No keystroke telemetries leave the user's browser.

## Site Structure & Documentation
- [Typing Test Engine & Comprehensive Guide](https://example.com/): The main interactive typing test along with in-depth WPM benchmark tables, ergonomic guides, and touch-typing tutorials.
- [About & Engineering Methodology](https://example.com/about.html): Details on the zero-latency input pipeline and scientific touch-typing principles.
- [Privacy Policy](https://example.com/privacy.html): Full explanation of local browser execution and strict GDPR/CCPA compliance.
